comment: Joel is the man! He is so kind and knowledgeable and you will learn a lot. All classes are powerpoint lessons (which he posts online) that are clear. Make sure to participate, and the 3 MCQ exams are simple if you pay attention. The group project requires a bit of work, but not hard if you put in the effort. I highly recommend this course.

Mier is simply my all-time favorite. 
I was a marketing major and I am now working as the marketing lead. 
I took like 4 of his courses during my college and he has always been my academic advisor. He didn't just tell you things in your textbook but how to be a successful marketer in your future career. 
TAKE HIM or at least go talk to him!

Really great professor! Great stories and real world application. Read a chapter per class. Participation really matters but he does a great job keeping you engaged. One of my best classes at UR. Cool group project throughout the semester.

Dr. Mier is the best professor I've had in the business school. I'm not a marketing major but he actually made the topic fairly interesting and he has some really great stories from his work in the private sector and with Netflix. His class is straightforward with three exams including the final and a fairly big group project at the end. Take him!!

Dr. Mier is an awesome professor. Great lecturer and knows how to keep a class energized, and he's a great guy to get to know outside of class. A group project is a large aspect of the class and could be overwhelming but if you follow his instructions you'll do fine. Tests are somewhat difficult so study well in advance.
